extra.description: Modeled projection of needle accuracy under block-diagonal Hadamard rotation
extra.projection: acc = acc_fp16 - (acc_fp16 - acc_k4v4) * 10**(-delta_db/10); delta_logp scaled identically; derived from a replay-adapter baseline, not from real-model forward passes
extra.config_id_note: 'k4v4_hadamard_projected' is a modeled projection, not a measured run
extra.ci_semantics: ci95_low/ci95_high are Wilson intervals over the baseline trial counts; they quantify sampling noise of the replay baseline and do NOT cover projection-model error, which is unbounded by this CSV
